title: Belva Davis, West Coast Trailblazer in TV News, Dies at 92
summary: Overcoming poverty and prejudice, she was the first Black woman to be hired as a television reporter in the region and later became a popular anchor.

title: China Hawks Grow Queasy Over Trump’s Push for Deals With Beijing
summary: President Donald Trump rewrote Washington’s rules for dealing with China in his first presidency, embracing confrontation, launching a trade war and upending decades of policy. In his second term, China hawks in Washington fear that Trump is going soft.
